description: Assembles a human-readable transcript for a Cognigy.AI session. Shows the conversation flow between user and bot in chronological order. Use this for reviewing conversation quality or debugging.

format.description: Output format: 'full' includes all metadata, 'compact' shows just the conversation flow

projectId.description: Optional project ID to scope the query

sessionId.description: The session ID to get transcript for

name: get_transcript
